entries.title: Cars 2

handoffNotes: Useful franchise contrast: violence level rises from Cars while other flags stay low.

franchiseCalibrationNotes: Cars stays mostly level 1-2 except violence.
Cars 2 and Cars 3 both justify violence level 3, for different reasons.
Pixar titles with low CSM ages can still have violence/scariness at level 3, so age alone should not be used to infer flags.
